description: This file defines the LocationValidator class, which validates Location objects in the OpenMRS system by checking for issues such as null or empty fields, duplicate names, circular parent location references, and field length constraints.

classes.name: LocationValidator
classes.description: A validator class for Location objects, implementing the Spring Validator interface and extending BaseCustomizableValidator to provide validation logic specific to Location entities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the Location class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Location object, checking for null/empty fields, duplicates, circular references, length constraints, and attribute validation.
